rationale: The short thesis remains intact as NBIS continues to trade near the bottom of its daily range (17.0%) and well below both the 5-minute 9-EMA ($88.93) and session VWAP ($89.85). Following a test of the $87.90 resistance level just below our $88.00 invalidation, the current price of $87.20 shows sellers are already rejecting the bounce on declining upward volume. With the broader market remaining weak (SPY -1.01%), the risk-to-reward profile strongly favors holding for a resumption of the downtrend toward the $83.50 target.
